name: fleet-rollout-smoke
title: Roll the durable lane out to the 9 fleet consumers with a per-repo smoke PR
description: Deploy the routed review lane to the nine fleet consumer repositories, of which one (sd-github-review, the router itself) currently carries the discovery descriptor and durable review workflow and eight carry neither. For each undeployed repository install the setup descriptor and the workflow_dispatch sd-review.yml lane through this repository's consumer installer (scripts/install-consumer.mjs), not the sd-ai-command-pack fleet refresh, which installs the pack rather than the lane. Then open one smoke pull request per repository and confirm the sd-github-review/receipt Check Run is published against it. --route-mode is required per consumer and has no default.
creator: sdelmas
notes: 2026-08-22: PAUSED pending 08-22-installer-secret-gate-mode-aware. Route mode is copilot for all eight undeployed consumers, revised from auto once the installer help surfaced that auto can bill the provider key. Switching modes does not unblock: the secret gate in planResources (plan.mjs:148) is unconditional and mode-blind, so copilot and none are refused for a missing PR_AGENT_MODEL_API_KEY exactly as auto is. Owner chose to fix the gate rather than distribute a live provider credential into eight repositories that will not spend it. External-repo scope approval was granted and still stands for when the blocker clears. All nine checkouts verified clean; nothing external mutated. Planning artifacts refreshed against the live manifest and a probe of all nine checkouts; design.md and implement.md added. Fleet is schema 5 with 9 consumers (people-profiles added at priority 80), not schema 4 with 8. Install mechanism corrected to this repository's consumer installer, not the sd-ai-command-pack fleet refresh. 2026-08-09: Prerequisites 08-08-installer-durable-lane and 08-09-descriptor-contract-path are archived; emitting artifacts verified present 2026-08-22. Execution mutates nine fleet repositories and opens a pull request in each. See prd.md Notes.
